class.name: HEGoGraphSurface
class.brief_description: Finds the ground under a [HEGoGraph3D] point, for snapping and for draping the path visualisation.
class.description:
The surface is, in order: [br]1. the graph's [member HEGoGraph3D.surface_provider] node, when it has a [code]sample_height(Vector2) -> float[/code] method (height in the provider's local space at a local x/z position). A [code]contains_position(Vector2) -> bool[/code] method, when present, limits where it answers. Nothing here depends on a particular terrain addon. [br]2. a physics ray straight down, when the graph's world has colliders.
A query that finds nothing returns an empty dictionary and callers keep the point's height.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Whether any surface source is available.

method.name: query
method.description: Surface under [param world_position] (only x and z matter). Returns [code]{"position": Vector3, "normal": Vector3}[/code] in world space, or an empty dictionary when there is no ground there.

method.name: query_local
method.description: Same as [method query], but in the graph's local space.

constants.constant: Sample spacing for estimating a normal from a height provider.
